name: finalization-ordering-trap
title: Planning finalization cannot absorb a review fix that lands after the journal commit
description: When a remote review lands after sd-ship Stage 2b's journal commit, the resulting review-fix commit sits between the captured finalization base and the head. Stage 4's receipt recomputation then fails bundle_scope_invalid for any fixed path that is not bookkeeping, and Stage 4 is forbidden from re-running finish-work, so the chain has no in-band exit. Give the chain a sanctioned route, or document the fresh sd-finish-work invocation as the required recovery.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Observed end-to-end on PR #157 (2026-08-06). Sibling of 08-06-work-loop-shipped-sha-after-branch-delete: both are cases where a documented call shape cannot be satisfied against the state the preceding stage actually leaves behind. Note that sd-ship and sd-finish-work are installed from the sd-ai-command-pack (.sd-ai-command-pack/manifest.json), so changing stage behaviour is upstream work; only this repository's spec guidance is editable locally. Sequencing: nine active tasks edit .trellis/spec/backend/quality-guidelines.md. Cluster membership is decided by the PRD's stated deliverable -- a Requirement or acceptance criterion that writes to that file -- not by whether implement.jsonl lists it, since the manifest is a read-for-context list and several non-cluster tasks cite the file as a contract to read. `order` 20 within the P2 band encodes the intended landing sequence (finalization ordering; extends the gate-ordering section). Tasks with no `order` sort as 0 and therefore run before this cluster, which is intended: they do not contend for this file.
